messages:
Hana Cole: Hey everyone! I'm Hana — started today in Platform, based in London. Big tea drinker, tiny desk-plant enthusiast, and tabletop-rpg nerd. :)
Sam Park: Welcome Hana!! :tada: Where in London are you? Also coffee or tea? :coffee:
Jamal Price: Hi Hana — welcome! I brought my D&D starter set to the office, happy to run a 1-shot sometime. Rooftop is great after 6pm.
Lia Nguyen: hey hana, welcome!! timezone? hours? we have a casual lunch crew wed 12:30 local — bring your fav snack :yum:
Karim Hassan: welcome! show us your plant when you get a badge, we have a 'pots and plants' channel. also ping me if you want a tour of the dev benches.
Tess Bhat: @Hana also fyi we have a 'tabletop' group for boardgame nights — last time we played Azul and it got heated :laughing:
Winslow Onboarding Bot: Hana Cole added to #new-hires, sent onboarding checklist -> https://redwood.example/onboarding/1779991234
Hana Cole: thanks all!! I'm near Shoreditch, normal hours + a couple late nights for EU/US overlap. Down for a game night and rooftop drinks :grimacing: :tea:
Sam Park: Shoreditch! we have a go-to place for ramen nearby — you're invited to the new-hires lunch this Friday.
Jamal Price: I'll DM you about TTRPG details. also, if you want a plant cutting, I have an aloe to spare.
Hana Cole: sold on the aloe and ramen. thanks everyone, excited to be here! :sparkles:
